title: 빛의 사각형
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie folk ballad. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar in a steady eighth-note pattern. Soft, breathy female vocals with intimate, close-mic production. Minimalist arrangement with subtle, atmospheric synth pads providing a low-frequency bed. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal delivery is conversational and delicate, utilizing light vibrato at the end of phrases. High-frequency air is prominent in the vocal mix, with a short room reverb.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals]
세 시예요
빛의 바닥에 사각형을 만들어요
정확한 네 변이에요
그 안에 사람이 하나 있어요
책을 편 채 잠들었어요
페이지가 바람에 넘어가요
아무도 읽지 않는 장이에요
[subtle synth pad enters]
먼지가 비
